title: Collections Desk Guide — Reconnection Payment for Disconnected Electric Service by Rate Schedule Accounts
content:
**Subject.** A member whose Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is disconnected for nonpayment and who asks to have power restored is told the reconnection payment, the amount the member pays on the spot toward reconnection. The member makes that payment personally, on the cooperative's automated phone payment line.

**When the figure is fixed.**

- The reconnection payment is fixed only after every bill left unpaid past its due date carries its late payment charge line on the account.
- The reconnection payment is not worked out until every meter test on the account that found the meter fast carries its meter error refund credit.

**Observable effect of the payment.** The member's payment posts on the disconnected account as a card payment dated today and lowers the account's current balance by the amount paid.

## The member's phone payment line

**Situation of use and capability.** `pay_reconnection_amount_66e1876e` is the member's own card payment toward getting power restored on an electric service account that stands disconnected for nonpayment, through the cooperative's automated phone payment line. It is not the line for an idle seasonal or irrigation account or for an account in service. One run posts a single card payment, dated today, to the disconnected account and lowers its current balance by the amount paid; the line reads back a confirmation number for the member to keep.

**How it is invoked.** This is a member-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it (through `call_user_discoverable_tool`) with the values the representative reads out.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | The reference number of the disconnected electric service account (one metered location) being paid, as the representative reads it from the service account lookup | Identifier |
| `payment_amount` | The amount the member pays, exactly as the representative quotes it | USD, positive, 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `payment_id` (the reference number of the posted payment), `service_account_id`, `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `payment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today), `payment_channel` (always `phone_ivr_card`, the automated phone card line), `payment_reference` (the eight-digit confirmation number the line issues), `account_balance` (the new balance, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status`, which reads "posted" when the payment is on the account.

### Contract questions

**Who runs the payment line?** The member. The representative unlocks and hands over the tool; the customer themselves enters the payment.

**Which channel does the payment post under?** Always the phone IVR card channel.
